author: Mehran Keivanimehr
meaning: Corrected code, restricted claims and completed experimental validation are separate states; no zero-error certification.

findings.change: 30-row corrected compute table; new code uses FMA=2 and no AMP/FP32-peak percentage
findings.required_evidence: None for arithmetic correction; new execution remains subject to the pilot

findings.change: Monotonic workload markers, bracketing raw queries, query uncertainty and fail-closed integration
findings.required_evidence: Long-window node runs; verify complete GPU coverage, sampling gaps, sensor behavior and energy sensitivity

findings.change: Generation-only window selected from worker monotonic timestamps; raw readings retained
findings.required_evidence: Run TP/DP pilot; independently recompute summaries from saved readings and worker boundaries

findings.change: Current A100 interpretation distinguishes allocator and sampled device memory; 16-GiB fit withdrawn
findings.required_evidence: Direct target-device execution only if the physical-fit claim is restored

findings.change: Forward and one-token batch estimates not called true TTFT; separate raw-event streaming client added
findings.required_evidence: Localhost serving runs with per-request raw events, token usage, engine metadata and independent restarts

findings.change: One token per request excluded; corrected quantity remains a separate-forward subtraction proxy
findings.required_evidence: Actual decode measurements require timestamps from the same generation call

findings.change: Future field renamed batch_completion_duration_s; no request percentile inferred from batch makespan
findings.required_evidence: Use streaming experiment for request-level distributions

findings.change: Actual optimizer-call hooks, all-step finite-loss checks, per-rank counters and optional gradient diagnostics
findings.required_evidence: Verify hooks under real DeepSpeed/AMP; inspect live states and parameter changes; compare short reference updates; A100 pending

findings.change: Current interpretations separate observations from bottleneck and host-setting hypotheses
findings.required_evidence: Retain hypotheses or acquire profiler traces plus intervention/control evidence; timing alone is insufficient

findings.change: Separate DDP/FSDP2/ZeRO protocol identities and live parameter dtype counters; no framework-only attribution
findings.required_evidence: Record live parameter/gradient/optimizer/compute dtypes; matched control required for framework-only claims

findings.change: Emulation-inclusive and native API flags separated; representative old coverage not described as ten-device coverage
findings.required_evidence: Run capability/finite-output checks on each allocated GPU; do not infer universal workload speed from GEMM

findings.change: Per-group sample CV and full range/median derived from all 28 successful main training groups; version-independent exact-rational statistics replace version-sensitive stdev rounding
findings.required_evidence: Five fresh process sessions per retained headline configuration is the starting design, not a guarantee of precision

findings.change: 832-token rating not applied to actual 768-token requests; token-capacity arithmetic traced to worker logs
findings.required_evidence: Scheduler occupancy/paging traces only if a KV-limit explanation is claimed

findings.change: Negative net differences retained; baseline readings and P-states logged; no calibrated net-efficiency claim
findings.required_evidence: Controlled before/after baselines, thermal/clock/P-state records and uncertainty; otherwise keep diagnostic

findings.change: Single-run point observations retained; new repetition protocol separates fresh sessions from within-run iterations
findings.required_evidence: Independent repeated sessions, balanced order, raw point plots and predefined precision/extension rules

findings.change: Titan full-model hash agreement across ranks, fixed model seed, pinned HF revision and CPU-seeded prompts; A6000 meta-path equivalence explicitly unverified
findings.required_evidence: Cross-framework full-state/input checks and short numerical reference runs; resolve A6000 meta initialization before claiming matched controls

findings.change: Untested batch fits, universal model ceilings and free precision recommendations removed from current interpretation
findings.required_evidence: Direct target configuration and numerical-quality evidence before restoring any prediction as a finding

findings.change: Analytical work distinguished from hardware counters; timed/whole-run device peaks separated; raw telemetry retained
findings.required_evidence: Verify raw trace windows on target hosts; profiling/quality evidence only for corresponding stronger claims
